//: English wording for the configurator (custom) ONLY — nothing in the game reads this file. Keys are the same ones translation.json holds, and the launcher picks one of the two files at random per run, so every key the dialog shows must be answered here or that row falls back to Russian mid-dialog. Same rules as translation.json: ';' separates variants (one is picked at random), '%s' is the value placeholder a frame title drops.
